text.en: Pulls the amount you type of the asset token from the Safe with `transferFrom`
text.zh-TW: 用 `transferFrom` 從 Safe 拉走你填的金額的資產代幣

text.en: Deposits the pulled USDC into this vault with `deposit`, which mints the shares to the Safe
text.zh-TW: 用 `deposit` 把拉來的 USDC 存進這個金庫，金庫把份額鑄給 Safe

text.en: OK to use. Steakhouse's docs page and CoinGecko both list this address. Send a small amount the first time.
text.zh-TW: 可以用。Steakhouse 文件頁和 CoinGecko 都列出這個地址，第一次先送小額。

pastTxsConclusion.en: That Safe's 1 other deposit goes through the newer VaultBundlesV1. EOAs mostly deposit with a permit signature instead; a Safe cannot use permit.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 那個 Safe 另 1 筆存款走較新的 VaultBundlesV1。EOA 多半改用 permit 簽名存，Safe 不能用 permit。

text.en: Within a year this vault grew from almost zero to about 132 million USDC. In one month, from 2026-04 to 2026-05, it went from about 8.3 million to about 63.2 million. The top 10 holders hold 54.06%.
text.zh-TW: 這個 vault 一年內從幾乎是零升到約 1.32 億 USDC，2026-04 到 2026-05 一個月內從約 830 萬升到約 6,320 萬；前 10 名持有人占 54.06%。

recommendation.en: Its size grew only within the past year; send a small amount first.
recommendation.zh-TW: 規模在一年內才長起來，先送小額。

role.en: USDC vault (V2, Prime Instant) managed by Steakhouse
role.zh-TW: Steakhouse 管理的 USDC vault（V2，Prime Instant）

role.en: The Morpho Vault V2 factory. It answers `isVaultV2` = true: it created this vault
role.zh-TW: Morpho Vault V2 工廠，它回答 `isVaultV2` = true，這個 vault 是它建立的
